assumptions.statement: No public RPC, testnet/mainnet submission, production key, or live price is used.
The deterministic signer is Anvil/Hardhat account 0, a universally public test key that must never hold assets.

Each generated object is a real signed EIP-1559 type-2 call with fixed nonce 7, value 0, priority cap 1 gwei, fee cap 30 gwei, empty access list, and network chain ID; calldata is the generated payload itself.
0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 is treated only as a no-code calldata sink for byte-derived no-op gas; no state or receipt is claimed.
Seeded-incompressible bytes are SHAKE-256 output domain-separated by family, byte length, and snapshot date; repeated bytes use the fixed ASCII pattern PQT-SP71-REPEATED-WITNESS|.
Admission statuses are projections from exact signed serialized length against ordinary sequencer rules, not receipt evidence; deposit, delayed, enforced, and bridge paths are distinct and excluded.
EIP-7623 floor and no-op calldata gas are exact byte-derived protocol calculations; verifier execution gas is not inferred from them.
Scroll calculations use an explicit 10,000,000 gas scenario from pinned genesis because current header gas is external state and was not queried.
All prices and scalars in scenarios.json are synthetic experiment inputs, not current, recent, historical, quoted, or live network values.

OP FastLZ compressed size is an exact source-traced port; Arbitrum Nitro Brotli-level-1 and Scroll codec-v8 zstd remain NOT_EVALUATED because the exact pinned executables are not retained in this repository.
Every calculated fee is labeled PROJECTION. Arbitrum and Scroll totals remain null while their exact compression result is unavailable.
v03-distribution.csv is H1 local Apple M4 Max measured source evidence; applying its total-gas columns to L2 gas caps is a feasibility projection, not an L2 verifier receipt.
H2 CI 8-core/32 GiB is unavailable and NOT_EVALUATED.
H3 commodity 16-core/64 GiB is unavailable and NOT_EVALUATED.
Hardware profile labels H1/H2/H3 in this package do not refer to hash candidates research/candidates/H1, H2, or H3.
Active runtime/initcode limits are checked at 24,576/49,152 bytes, but no exact verifier bytecode artifact was supplied, so artifact-specific deployment feasibility is NOT_EVALUATED.
Finality and withdrawal entries describe pinned protocol assumptions, not measured wall-clock latency or guarantees under dishonest operators/governance.
